verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS meeting assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documented switch to opt out of telemetry or usage tracking. The related items (0-day vendor data retention, private storage, and rules-engine privacy controls for meeting access) are adjacent privacy features, not a usage-tracking opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
